faqs.a:
Connector
means a short section of piping, typically not exceeding two feet, which can be bent
               and used for connections between rigid service piping. Also referred to as a gooseneck
               or pigtail. Connectors are not considered to be part of the service line but may require
               replacement.
Consecutive system
means a public water system that receives some or all of its finished water from
               one or more wholesale systems. Delivery may be through a direct connection or through
               the distribution system of one or more consecutive systems.
Customer-owned service line
means the portion of the drinking water service line from the meter (typically located
               in a meter pit) to the point of entry or the foundation of the home or building. The
               property owner is responsible for maintenance. Also referred to as the "private" or
               "user" side.
Director
means the director of utilities or designee thereof.
Engineering standards
means the city's Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications, as may be amended
               from time to time.
Lead service line ("LSL")
means a portion of pipe that is made of lead, which connects the drinking water main
               to the building inlet, not including connectors. A galvanized service line is considered
               a lead service line if it ever was or is currently downstream of any lead service
               line or service line of unknown material. For the purposes of this article, any galvanized
               water service line installed before 1960 will be treated as an LSL, requiring replacement.
Point of entry
means the location where the water service line enters the structure (home or building)
               at the foundation; the junction where it ties into the premise plumbing.
Premise plumbing
means the drinking water supply plumbing materials located within a property (in-house
               or in-building), past the point of entry and leading to each internal tap or appurtenance.
Service line
means a drinking water supply pipe from the water main to the meter, or the meter
               to the point of entry of the structure. This definition does not apply to irrigation
               lines or fire protection lines.
System-owned service line
means the portion of the drinking water service line from the water main to the meter
               pit, maintained by the city, also referred to as the "public" side.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
